blocks.text: By regulation, the Lieutenant Governor in Council may impose a levy on stumpage bearing timber for which stumpage is determined and payable under the Forest Act.
If a regulation imposing a levy is made, the Forest Act applies to the enforcement and collection of the levy as if it were stumpage payable under that Act.
The Lieutenant Governor in Council may make regulations referred to in section 41 of the Interpretation Act.
